Maya: Heads-up from today's int4-v3 onboard A/B: session-length cohort shows a clear rerank MRR drop.
Maya: Metric summary: RERANK_MRR_session = baseline 0.701 -> int4-v3 0.677 (-3.4%), n=8.6k, p=0.002.
Maya: Shadow run id shadow-2024-11-07-02, eval config attached in run.
Jonah: Can you share SE and whether decoding/temp/beam changed versus baseline?
Maya: SE ~0.6%, decoding params identical (temp=0.0, beam=1). Plot & raw: https://redwood.internal/evals/EV-9354
Oliver: Our canary gating is currently global-threshold based. This cohort is heavy tail; suggests cohort-aware gating. We should cap cohort traffic during canary — propose max 5% for session_long until stable.
Anya: Also recommend tagging the variant (int4-v3-prefill) and fail-fast auto-fallback at 2% MRR for critical cohorts.
Samir: Noted. int4-v3 uses a different prefill alignment strategy. Two quick experiments: kv_warmup=true and prefill_pad=64 to align KV offsets. Could also try sticky-prefill to preserve state across segments.
Maya: Re-ran a targeted shadow with kv_warmup=true & prefill_pad=64. New delta: -0.3% (n=8.2k). Upload: https://redwood.internal/evals/EV-9354/rerun1
Jonah: Great signal reduced. Looks like alignment issue. Can we add a small preflight smoke that runs 200 session-long queries and checks per-query rank concordance?
Oliver: Yes. Action items: 1) update canary.json to include cohort caps and cohort-specific thresholds, 2) add session_long to critical_slices list, 3) add preflight smoke for session statefulness. If any critical cohort exceeds 2% regression, auto-fallback.
deploy-bot: canary.json patched (PR #4123) and canary deploy initiated :rocket: (patch id canary-20241107-03)
eval-bot: targeted shadow run complete (run id: shadow-20241107-02a) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Filing follow-ups: EV-9355 (cohort-gating rules), EV-9356 (prefill smoke test). I'll also update variant tag naming convention to include prefill flags.
Anya: :eyes: add note to release playbook about cohort caps.
Samir: Also log the prefill param used with every inference trace so we can attribute regressions quickly.
Maya: will add trace field. Closing thread unless anyone objects.
